template.subject: Quick question from an OKC crew owner
template.html_body:
Hi {{NAME}},

I'm Aaron — I run a crew in Oklahoma City and built MowGo, a scheduling app for 1-3 person crews.

I'm reaching out to crews in {{CITY}} to see how they handle the scheduled + on-demand mix. Most guys I talk to say phone-based booking gets messy the second rain or cancellations hit.

Do you use a system, or does it all live in your head?

I've got {{CITY}} rate benchmarks if you want to see how your pricing stacks up. No pitch, just curious.


Aaron
Owner, MowGo
mowgoapp.com
